name: Midlothian Towne Crossing

With its convenient location and strong local reputation, the center serves as a neighborhood hub for everyday shopping and lifestyle needs.

description: Midlothian Towne Crossing is a community shopping center strategically located at 2040 Farm to Market Road 663 in Midlothian, Texas, serving the rapidly growing southern Dallas-Fort Worth metropolitan area. This open-air center has established itself as a convenient neighborhood destination for residents seeking a diverse mix of shopping, dining, and lifestyle services. The center features a well-curated tenant mix spanning multiple categories including retail shops, restaurants and eateries, lifestyle services, and health-focused businesses, making it a comprehensive hub for daily needs. The center's strategic location along a major thoroughfare provides excellent visibility and easy access for the surrounding residential communities, positioning it as a go-to destination for families and professionals in this thriving suburban market.
